subject.title: fix(ios): avoid inactive Voice Wake audio startup

question: Should this PR remove the root CHANGELOG.md entry before merge, or should a maintainer explicitly accept that release-owned edit?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and proven, but root CHANGELOG.md is release-owned by repository policy and the PR has a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Remove root changelog entry
options.body: Drop only the root CHANGELOG.md line and keep the PR body/app-specific release context before normal maintainer review.

options.title: Accept release-owned edit
options.body: A maintainer may intentionally keep the hand-written root changelog entry despite the release-generation policy.

options.title: Pause for release owner
options.body: Hold the PR until the release owner decides how this entry should be handled.

recommendation.title: Remove root changelog entry
recommendation.body: Drop only the root CHANGELOG.md line and keep the PR body/app-specific release context before normal maintainer review.
